Hash-bound wrapper/report/result identities, pinned source files, completed assessment, native H1 scope, byte/row bounds and final input rechecks retain original provenance.

No scorer/assessor import, DB/network read, fitted model, economic rescoring or mutation of the original artifacts occurs in the summarizer. Output is exclusive; existing output remains retained.
